Is there a way to log into Voat that doesn't use Javascript?

Good question! Yes it is possible to login without JavaScript.

  1. Right click the page
  2. Inspect element
  3. Locate element with id="mustbeloggedinModal"
  4. change css display:none; to display:block; and change opacity to opacity:1;.

That will show you the login dialog and will let you login without JavaScript.

• Number 5 is basically just the Trackr, an old Kickstarter-based gizmo. I tried it; it's lame. First, those are pretty thick in your wallet. Second, prepare for false-alarms galore. In the course of a day, it's inevitable that Bluetooth will have a hiccup or two, and when it causes an alarm on your phone, that can be intrusive.

  • The "Coin" wallet: Chip+PIN or Chip+Sign won't work with this, nor will most merchants abroad like it at all, so, uhm, no.

  • The weird suitcase: Okay, looking at this, my immediate raction is that for this to work, you need each shelf to fold perfectly on the last, with no wasted space. Yeah, right. A far easier solution is packing cubes: just unpack them into your hotel's dresser, or dig at them right in the bag. As you move items out of the cubes and wear them, just throw them loose in your suitcase and it's clear what's clean. Simpler, lower maintenance, more versatile, and far less likely to break.

Might I suggest some alternative travel gadgets:

  1. Tide Sink Packets + Sink Stop + Camping clothesline. If you're traveling for adventure, unless you plan on doing some serious overpacking, you'll need to do laundry along the way. You can use a fancy hotel dry cleaning bag, or just do laundry in the sink. This is the way to go.

  2. An unlocked GSM phone with a big battery. The Moto Maxx will work. When you arrive anywhere -- maybe even Africa -- you can usually get an affordable SIM card at the airport with data, a local number, and calling. Far easier and cheaper option than data roaming, and probably with better coverage.

  3. An in-flight kit with earplugs, a sleep mask, and various medications -- especially stomach ones. Nothing sucks like having a digestion upset on a plane.

  4. To avoid pickpockets, pants with hidden front zipping pockets.

How are you going to obtain cards in this game? Do you get them from gameplay, or will you have to buy online booster packs similar to physical trading card games?

Right now, when you play a match against a real person you obtain gold. If you win the math, the gold is multiplied. So, if you are really good at the game you can get new cards by buying them with gold relatively easily.
